law: TB-22 (frozen contract rev 3, owner-ratified): from ratification no new durable task/attempt/workspace/eval/approval/delivery store is added to ZeroClaw, and no annex table gains new writers. Freeze-no-growth also means no new WRITER PATH to any annex table. Enforcement: this checked-in manifest enumerates the codebase's detected persistence surface (case-insensitive sqlite DDL incl. .sql/.txt/.md files, rusqlite connection sites, store-crate name mentions (alias-proof), OpenOptions write paths, embedded-store crate deps); CI diffs the manifest against the detected surface; ANY drift (new file, removed file, new store crate) fails this gate and requires a PR-visible manifest change citing a TB-22 exemption. Detection is signature-based, not semantic: constructed DDL strings or a hand-rolled file store can still evade it - the gate's contract is drift VISIBILITY plus a PR-visible manifest change, with human review as the authority, not impossibility. The only standing exemptions per the contract: TB-19 watch cursors and the TB-7 outstanding-tuple journal (neither exists yet; neither is granted here).
